attr.title: Art of War 2: Global Confederation
attr.desc: Real-time strategy from the Nokia 5800 era. Build a base, train infantry and vehicles, research upgrades and fight through seven campaign missions. The original game code runs natively on a built-in Java runtime, with no emulator.
attr.inst: Copy your ArtOfWar2__Nokia_5800.jar (Nokia 5800 edition, version 1.4.0) into ports/artofwar2/gamedata/.
